'''Swordmancer Dagger''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC Factory. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|One of the products marketed by the Bureau of Swordmancers in its early days.
An extremely sharp tactical blade, and one of the earliest iterations of HS.Swords weaponry production technique. There is no doubt that this equipment has laid down solid foundations for the subsequent Yinglung-series.}}
